text: Models normally do all their reasoning in a continuous hidden state instead of spitting out readable text which makes them hard to monitor. The authors tested the Coconut and CODI models and it turns out these models barely even use their hidden reasoning steps for logical tasks like PrOntoQA and ProsQA.
